items.question: How long does it take to build an agent?
items.answer: A working first version usually takes less than a month. Getting it into production with your data, permissions and approvals takes around three months. From there it grows with your needs.

items.question: What return can we expect, and how do you measure it?
items.answer: Before we build anything, we measure how long the task takes today and how often it runs. After launch we measure again. The return is the time saved multiplied by the cost of that time, minus what the agent costs to run. If the numbers do not justify an agent, we tell you.

items.question: Do you build custom agents or use ready-made ones?
items.answer: Both. Where a ready-made tool does the job, we set it up and connect it. Where your process is specific, we build a custom agent around it. The choice depends on what gets you the result fastest and cheapest.

items.question: Where is our data processed, and is it used for training?
items.answer: We use enterprise AI plans whose terms exclude training on your data. Where your rules require it, we host models and data on infrastructure you control. Processing follows the GDPR, and we document where every piece of data goes.

items.question: What happens after launch?
items.answer: We monitor the agent, fix what breaks and improve it as your process changes. You can keep us on a support plan or take it over fully.

items.question: Can our team maintain the agents ourselves?
items.answer: Yes. We work alongside your team, document everything and train the people who will own the agent, so you are never locked in.

ai-agents.title: AI agent development
ai-agents.summary: Custom agents that run multi-step work across your tools and hand the result to a person to approve.
ai-agents.intro: An agent is software that can read, check and act across several systems, the way an assistant would, but in minutes and without getting tired. We design the agent around one of your real processes, connect it to your tools and make sure a person approves anything that matters before it leaves.

automation.title: Process automation
automation.summary: End-to-end workflows that remove copy-paste, data entry and manual hand-offs.
automation.intro: Many processes still depend on someone copying data from one screen to another. We map the process as it is, remove the manual steps and connect the systems directly, with AI only where it adds something rules cannot.

integration.title: Integration
integration.summary: AI connected to Excel, CRM, ERP, email and databases through secure connectors and APIs.
integration.intro: AI is only useful when it can see your data and act in your systems. We build secure connectors between AI tools and the software you already run, so information flows where it is needed and access stays limited to what you approve.

sections.heading: Who is responsible
body: Qartmina, Les Berges du Lac, Tunis, Tunisia, is responsible for the processing of personal data on this website. You can reach us at fares@qartmina.com.

sections.heading: What we collect and why
body: Contact form: your name, email address, company, website and message. We use them only to reply to your request and, if it leads to a project, to prepare it. Legal basis: steps taken at your request before a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
Newsletter: your email address, only if you subscribe. Legal basis: your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR), which you can withdraw at any time through the link in every email.
Security check: to protect our forms from spam, Cloudflare Turnstile checks that a request comes from a person. Legal basis: our legitimate interest in protecting the website (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
Server logs: our hosting provider records technical data such as IP address, date and requested page to run the website securely. Legal basis: legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

sections.heading: Service providers
body: Brevo (Sendinblue SAS, France) sends our contact form emails and our newsletter.
Cloudflare, Inc. (United States) provides the Turnstile security check. Transfers to the United States are covered by the EU-US Data Privacy Framework or standard contractual clauses.
We do not sell your data and we do not use advertising or tracking cookies.

sections.heading: Cookies and local storage
body: This website stores your colour theme and language preference in your browser. The security check and the newsletter form may set technically necessary cookies. We do not use analytics or advertising cookies.

sections.heading: How long we keep data
body: Contact requests are deleted when they are no longer needed, at the latest two years after our last exchange, unless a contract requires us to keep them longer. Newsletter data is kept until you unsubscribe.

sections.heading: Your rights
body: You have the right to access, correct, delete and restrict the processing of your data, to data portability and to object to processing. You can withdraw consent at any time. Write to fares@qartmina.com. You also have the right to complain to a data protection authority.

sections.heading: Scope
body: These terms apply to the use of the website qartmina.com. Consulting and development projects are governed by a separate written agreement.

sections.heading: Content
body: The content of this website is general information and not professional advice for your specific situation. We keep it accurate and up to date but cannot guarantee that it is complete at all times.

sections.heading: Intellectual property
body: Texts, graphics and code on this website belong to Qartmina unless stated otherwise. You may share links to our pages. Any other reuse requires our written permission.

sections.heading: External links
body: We link to external sources as evidence. We are not responsible for the content of external websites.

sections.heading: Liability
body: We are liable without limitation for intent and gross negligence. For slight negligence we are liable only for breach of essential obligations and limited to foreseeable damage.

sections.heading: Applicable law
body: These terms are governed by the law stated in our legal notice, without prejudice to mandatory consumer protection rules in your country of residence.
